annual_basis: The only full year for which any public document prints a Rebyota sales figure is 2025, stated in an issuer press release (6-K) of RedHill Biopharma, which acquired the commercialization rights from Ferring (private) in 2026.

launch_evidence.quote: More than 5,000 patients have been treated with Rebyota in the three years since it was launched in the US in January 2023. (Ferring Group Annual Report 2025, page 15 of the PDF; read with pdfplumber, where the two-column layout interleaves the sentence across lines)

notes: Single-year series. The figure is RedHill's prose statement 'generated approximately $16.9 million in 2025 U.S. net sales' (also printed in RedHill's 6-K of 30 September 2026, 0001104659-26-112334), so it is approximate (one decimal); it is Ferring's U.S. net sales, not RedHill's. Combined Rebyota + Clenpiq 2025 net sales are stated as approximately $37.5 million; Clenpiq is not part of this series. Ferring (private, Swiss) Annual Report 2025 prints Gastroenterology franchise sales of EUR 456 million (2024: 467) and its franchise table itemises only 'of which Pentasa' under Gastroenterology, so no Ferring-published Rebyota figure was found; the Ferring 2025 annual-report PDF returns HTTP 403 to a bare research User-Agent but downloads with a browser User-Agent and was re-read directly with pdfplumber (the 2024 and 2023 report URLs tried returned 404); it contains no Rebyota sales figure, so no Ferring URL is cited as a data row. 2023 and 2024 Rebyota sales: no public document found. RedHill reports from the third quarter 2026; the 2026 third-quarter report was not yet published at the time of sourcing.
